title: plantar arch
body:
You're late and I'm waiting,
i look at the arch on the bench.
I see anxiety spread out everywhere,
some gentlemen talk about the subway.

And they all go, somewhere they go;
to everywhere and to nothing and back they turn.
Flying pigeons,
where is the hope they are looking for?

I wait and breathe
the minutes I have to live away from you.
I'm always going, but where am I going?
i have left but I will come back here again
waiting for you.

Hasty drivers are waiting for the traffic light;
navarinou is full of people.
Two boys get a kiss in time,
before the fuel smells of mint.

And everyone goes, somewhere they go…
